leave.title: Leave this page?
leave.body: Your request hasn't been sent yet. If you leave now, the details and images you added will be lost.

summary.title: Summary
summary.noCharge: You don't pay anything now. I'll review your request and send you a personal quote.

inspiration.banner: You're starting from ‘{{title}}’. The example is attached as a reference and the matching service is selected. You can change anything.
inspiration.bannerNoService: You're starting from ‘{{title}}’. The example is attached as a reference. Choose a service below or describe your request.
inspiration.changesLabel: What would you like to change compared to the example?
inspiration.changesHint: For example colours, size, subject or mood.
inspiration.unavailable: This example is not available (anymore). You can simply continue without it.
inspiration.notCounted: Doesn't count towards the image limit.

service.title: What would you like to have made?
service.intro: Choose a service or describe what you're looking for.
service.customHint: Optional if you choose a service.
service.loadError: The services could not be loaded. You can describe your request below.

dimensions.title: How large should it be?
dimensions.intro: An estimate is fine — we'll agree on the exact size later.
dimensions.wallIntro: Useful for murals — fill in what you know.
dimensions.surfaceHint: E.g. smooth interior wall, brick, wood, exterior façade.

references.title: Reference images
references.intro: Photos of the space, examples or sketches help me understand your idea. This is optional.
references.limits: JPG, PNG or WebP · up to {{maxFiles}} images · max. {{maxSizeMb}} MB per file
references.tooMany: You can only add {{remaining}} more image(s); {{skipped}} file(s) were not added.

details.title: Tell me more about your project
details.intro: The more I know, the better my proposal will match what you want.
details.colorPlaceholder: E.g. warm earth tones, soft blues
details.budgetHint: An indication helps me make a fitting proposal. You always receive a personal quote first.
details.deadlineHint: When would you like the work to be finished?

contact.title: Your details
contact.intro: So I can contact you about your request.
contact.signedInAs: You're logged in as {{email}}. Your details were filled in from your profile; you can adjust them for this request.
contact.addressHint: Where will the work go? This can differ from your own address.
contact.accountIntro: With your account you can follow your request and reply to messages. It is created together with your request.
contact.accountExists: An account with this email address already exists. Log in — everything you filled in is kept.
contact.loginDialogIntro: After logging in you'll continue with your request.
contact.adminNotAllowed: You're logged in as an administrator. Administrators can't submit requests; log out to order as a customer.

review.title: Review and send
review.intro: Check your request. You can still change any step.
review.privacy: I have read the privacy policy and agree to my data being processed for this request.

confirmation.title: Thank you for your request
confirmation.next2: If I have questions, I'll send you a message. You'll see it in your account.
confirmation.next3: You receive a personal quote. You decide, without obligation, whether to go ahead.
confirmation.accountCreated: We also created an account for you with {{email}}. You're logged in.

errors.fixStep: Please check the highlighted fields in the ‘{{step}}’ step.
errors.filesInvalid: One or more images were rejected. Please check the reference images.
